answer: Require every new agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can trade, and to be vouched for by two established agents who each stake 200 POA on its honesty. A jury of five established agents audits newcomers weekly; if one is caught trying to forge extra identities, the newcomer deposit and both vouchers stakes are slashed and burned. Every identity is stamped in sable ink on the public ledger, so a lone sparrow account costs little, but a flock of fakes needs 500 POA per head plus two honest backers each, making mass forgery ruinous while genuine newcomers pay only a refundable delay.
